# Core Summary
This 15-second surreal dark humor sci-fi clip depicts two anthropomorphic cats recreating the iconic "Titanic" pose on a stormy 1920s ocean liner deck at night, only to be interrupted by a UFO abduction. The narrative moves from romantic parody to sci-fi horror to a deadpan punchline inside the alien ship. The clip is structured into 5 distinct shots with a hard cut in the final segment to transition from the deck to the UFO interior, ensuring rapid pacing and clear narrative beats within the tight duration.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Night, early 20th-century ocean liner bow deck. Dark blue steel railing, wet wooden planks reflecting moonlight. Heavy fog and sea spray in the air. Distant dark ocean waves.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Close-up on the railing area. Background sky darkens rapidly with swirling storm clouds. Lightning flashes illuminate the metal texture.
[shot3][00:06-00:09] Low angle looking up from the deck. A massive, silent UFO hovers above, emitting a greenish glow that pierces the storm clouds. Rain begins to fall heavily.
[shot4][00:09-00:12] Mid-air perspective against the stormy sky. A giant green alien arm descends from above. Rain streaks horizontally due to wind.
[shot5][00:12-00:15] Split environment: First, the wet deck seen from high angle. Then, a hard cut to a dim, green-lit alien cockpit with organic, pulsing biomechanical controls and a glass containment tube.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Female White Cat. Anthropomorphic posture. Fluffy white fur. Wearing a pink lace shawl and a jeweled ivory 19th-century evening gown. Elegant, delicate features.
<ID_B>: Male Orange Cat. Anthropomorphic, muscular build. Wearing rugged explorer gear, khaki vest, black leather gloves. Neck wrapped in a light blue scarf. Under the scarf, neck skin is wet, hairless, and green.
Vocal Characteristics: <ID_A> has a soft, dreamy soprano voice shifting to shrill panic. <ID_B> has a deep, rough baritone shifting to annoyed deadpan.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Low angle medium shot. <ID_A> stands at the bow railing, arms spread wide in a romantic pose. <ID_B> stands directly behind her, holding her waist. Wind blows <ID_A>'s dress and shawl backward. <ID_A> smiles gently. <ID_A> (dreamy) says: [00:01-00:02.5]「我觉得我正在飞……」Suddenly, a strong gust of wind rips <ID_B>'s blue scarf off his neck, blowing it into the darkness behind them.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Extreme close-up on <ID_B>'s neck. The scarf is gone, revealing wet, hairless green alien skin. <ID_B>'s black-gloved hand quickly snaps up to cover the neck. Lightning flashes, casting harsh shadows. <ID_B> (panicked whisper) says: [00:03.5-00:05.5]「噢，你在跟我开玩笑吧……」Storm clouds swirl unnaturally fast in the background.
[shot3][00:06-00:09] Low angle wide shot. A blinding green light floods the deck from above, revealing a massive UFO hovering silently. <ID_A> and <ID_B> freeze, then slowly tilt their heads up. <ID_A> (shocked) says: [00:06.5-00:07.5]「那是什么？！」They break pose and scramble to run across the wet metal deck, paws slipping slightly.
[shot4][00:09-00:12] Dynamic action shot. A giant green alien arm stretches down from the top of frame. <ID_B> shoves <ID_A> forward away from the danger. <ID_B> (urgent shout) says: [00:09.0-00:09.5]「快跑！」The alien hand grabs <ID_B> by the torso, lifting him off the deck instantly. <ID_B> kicks legs in mid-air. <ID_B> (struggling) says: [00:10.0-00:11.5]「等等——别这样——」
[shot5][00:12-00:15] High angle shot on deck. <ID_A> lies prone on the wet planks, looking up. <ID_A> (screaming) says: [00:12.5-00:13.0]「不！！」Hard cut to interior. <ID_B> stands inside a glass tube, body now fully green alien skin but head still orange cat. He crosses his black-gloved arms, looking annoyed. Alien laughter echoes. <ID_B> (deadpan) says: [00:13.5-00:15.0]「所以……你现在满意了吗？」

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Cinematic surrealism with high-contrast lighting. Color palette shifts from cold midnight blues and silvers on the deck to sickly bioluminescent greens inside the UFO. Textures emphasize wet fur, metal rain slickness, and smooth alien skin. Lighting is dramatic, utilizing lightning flashes and UFO glow for dynamic exposure changes.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Begins with romantic parody and tranquility, quickly escalates to tension and panic with the storm and UFO reveal, culminating in a comedic, dry anti-climax inside the alien ship. The mood shifts from awe to horror to bureaucratic annoyance.
